title: Test that control_cleanup_pending names the recorded cleanup cause, and the confirm-absence failure path
outcome: Deterministic tests cover the Engram control cleanup cause. One test sets a retained EngramControlProcess's cleanup_failure to Some(cause) with cleanup_finished false. It asserts that process_for_until's control_cleanup_pending refusal message contains that cause, and that the fallback messages appear when no cause is recorded. A Unix test drives finish_engram_control_cleanup through the failure path where the group is still present after the reap, or through the EPERM → ConfirmAbsenceAfterReap branch, without relying on a macOS kernel race. Optionally, shutdown_session_until's reset-path errors also carry the recorded cause, for consistency.
acceptance: a test asserts that process_for_until's control_cleanup_pending message contains a recorded cleanup_failure cause, and one asserts the fallback message when none is recorded
a Unix test exercises finish_engram_control_cleanup's confirm-absence failure path or the EPERM confirm-after-reap branch deterministically
the change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
